name: 説明付き設定切替ブロック
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0006 説明付き設定切替ブロック.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE explanatory OFF-toggle block, source normalized region16,197,358,83. Only Japanese text: small section heading 動画; row label タイルに動画を表示しない; supporting line 発表中の画面のみ表示します. Keep Meiryo Regular heading12/16, row14/24, support12/16, tracking0. Single white rounded card, two text lines aligned left and OFF switch at right, white round thumb on LEFT on neutral gray track. Original controls switch anatomy, proportions and alignment; preserve OFF, do not turn green or move thumb right. No icons exist here. Heading directly on pure-white canvas above card, no extra outer card or tinted page. Source dark theme is adapted to binding white official system. Keep compact358px logical width and64px card height, scale uniformly into readable wide1536x600 output with restrained white margins. Do not add completion action, phone, rows, controls or copy.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No accent is warranted: control is OFF. Preserve neutral gray track and left white thumb; adding forest-green here would falsely imply enabled state.
reviewNotes: 原版全体/crop/保存mockを目視。対象内は無彩色OFF状態でaccent不要と判断。生成後に動画見出し、説明2行、左つまみのOFF、白cardとcanvas、追加glyphなしを目視確認。原版のswitch構造を優先しgrayを保持。操作/font同一性/native編集/所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
